[about]
Shivalik Ventures is a Mumbai-based real estate developer focused on delivering residential living spaces with an emphasis on construction quality, transparency, on-time delivery, and value appreciation. The company highlights decades of experience in the real estate sector and promotes accessible housing options in key Mumbai locations. :contentReference[oaicite:0]{index=0}
